title: Whole-state check
purpose: Every gate (lint, test-hygiene, test-patterns, test-dashboard) + telemetry + cost + TODO in-flight. --json for wrappers.

title: Spend gate (fail closed)
purpose: Refuses (exit 1) unless keys, last gate run, balance and model policy all pass. Run before any paid session.

title: Model catalog + cost policy
purpose: ALLOW / ASK / BLOCK from models.policy.json; also the data behind the /models page.

title: Learned rules (corpus)
purpose: Contrastive (state, action, outcome) rules -> data/observability/learned-rules.json; the guard reads them.

title: Solution library
purpose: Recurring errors and the next action that fixed each -> solutions.json; shown on /explore > patterns.

title: Search (ranked + fuzzy)
purpose: FTS5/bm25 over every part; --fuzzy tolerates typos (edti -> edit).

title: Telemetry
purpose: guard actions, tool errors + traces, events, app log, container log, packet hint.

title: Doc budget
purpose: Token size + content hash of the read-first corpus; unchanged hash = nothing new to re-learn.

title: Blacklist guard self-test
purpose: Proves block/fix/warn plus interpreter-wrapper and pipe-to-shell catches.

title: Tool contract tests
purpose: Asserts every --json tool emits the keys a wrapper reads.

title: Health check
purpose: Ordered tiers; --full adds the Jev proof (Tier 9) and repo gates (Tier 10).

title: UX test (Playwright)
purpose: Asserts the served pages: console clean, no 390px overflow, tabs toggle, overview compact.
commands: pip install playwright && playwright install chromium

title: Read a screenshot locally
purpose: OCR fallback when image input is unavailable (tesseract / PaddleOCR); searchable via /api/semantic.

title: Cost accounting
purpose: DeepSeek balance + per-session cost + Jev count; bottlenecks, model mix, prompt cache, context budget.
